packaged_extensions: STUDIOHUB_PACKAGED and STUDIOHUB_REQUIRE_AUTH authenticated loopback mode
deliberate_adaptations: Registry recognizes only Image, Voice and independent Subtitle descriptors, and loads the truthful nonempty subset currently running from the private manifest; no fixed ports or Pinokio checkout discovery.
The packaged API registers only Hub jobs, Subtitle jobs, settings, workers and model-package lifecycle routes.
Packaged authentication rejects uncredentialed loopback API access and disables the legacy default owner password.
The legacy Git/pterm updater and lifecycle paths are not registered; release identity is supplied by the packaging manifest.

Packaged local worker descriptors use their declared private endpoint even when their stable physical machine ID differs from the legacy local key; worker-supplied absolute URLs must match that endpoint before a Studio credential is attached.
Queued and restored Subtitle batches recheck the packaged model/runtime/OS admission gate before physical-machine leasing; Voice workers cannot serve as their fallback.

Packaged Subtitle HTTP attempts whose worker outcome is unknown retain their attempt identity and require manual action after response loss, gateway timeout, cancellation, or Hub restart; delivered 400/401/409/503 worker refusals keep the retained error or retry behavior without holding a physical-machine fence. The retained Pinokio lane keeps its historical retry behavior.
Exact GenStudio Subtitle replays and payload conflicts are checked against the durable execution fence before current model readiness, without persisting a new fence for refused submissions.

Packaged Subtitle dispatch does not start the retained legacy output cleanup timer; terminal cleanup remains with the forthcoming shared protected-output policy, while the original launcher mode keeps its timer.

A possibly accepted packaged Subtitle attempt persists its physical machine identity; uncertain items hold that machine in the existing shared admission lease after Hub restart until worker reconciliation is available.
Existing verified artifact receipt and generation statistics APIs are mounted on the authenticated packaged Hub without changing their retained ledger contracts.
Existing authenticated machine and studio pause controls are mounted for packaged workers and wake the shared schedulers after an operator change.
Model package file verification is combined with separate runtime, OS/chip and later scheduler admission state; files_verified is never reported as dispatch-ready.
